tiles.title: From supplied build commands to EC2 deployment

steps.visual_purpose: Make the buildspec's phase command lists and artifact selection visible alongside the supplied generated output path, phase-log evidence, and exported-file evidence.

steps.mapping_rule: profile override live_code->tool_simulation: default for practice type tool_simulation

steps.visual_purpose: Make the selected application, deployment group, EC2 targets and revision visible alongside the approved service role and agent status, supplied AppSpec file mappings and hooks, deployment hook results, and corresponding files inspected on the target.
Make the bounded-test timeline visible with metric values, the metric target, scaling activities and resulting capacity, alongside instance warmup and minimum, desired and maximum capacity settings.

Make the publisher and consumer repository-policy grants visible alongside their identity-policy authentication permission, with expected and observed results for publisher push, consumer pull and the unapproved-principal repository-access test.

Make each supplied image's tags, digest, count or age eligibility, deployed or still-needed status, and previewed expiry decision visible together so an unsafe overlap can be identified before application.

Make the request path visible from listener protocol and port through routing-rule evaluation and target-group forwarding to registered target protocol and port. Annotate health-check path, port, success codes and target health reasons. Contrast normal healthy-target routing with the all-registered-targets-unhealthy fail-open exception.
Show the intended log group's inspected retentionInDays beside the supplied retention requirement so that their agreement can be verified.

Make visible the intended source DB instance, its available manual snapshot, the separate restored instance with an available status and its own endpoint, and the supplied query result containing the expected recovery marker.
Show the scoped reader policy alongside approved and unapproved principal test results, making the read actions, supported resource scopes, and allowed or denied outcomes visible.

Show the supplied image, ports and resource settings alongside the registered task definition and the resulting task's status and container details, making the distinction between configuration and runtime evidence visible.

Make the denied request's principal, operation, resource and context visible alongside applicable identity, resource, session, boundary and organization policies. Highlight the evidence establishing the decisive deny, missing allow or unsatisfied condition, then show the smallest approved correction and the same operation's retest result.
Make the approved plan's EC2 settings visible beside the created instance's actual settings, with the instance identity and retained apply outcome separately identified as execution evidence.

steps.mapping_rule: profile override live_code->tool_simulation: default for practice type tool_simulation

steps.visual_purpose: Make the approved target set and actual invocation targets visible alongside the shared command ID and each node's status and output, so scope discrepancies and differing outcomes remain distinguishable from the parent command status.

Make the supplied invalid EC2 declaration and its correction visible alongside the workflow gate order, validation exit result, and apply step's blocked or executed status. Show a formatting-only change separately from a configuration-validity failure.

steps.mapping_rule: profile override live_code->tool_simulation: default for practice type tool_simulation
